paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between ST Token Number C and both Accuracy (%) and Inference time (ms). The x-axis, labeled “ST Token Number C”, is linear, ranging from 0 to 30 with tick marks every 5 units. The primary y-axis, on the left, represents Accuracy (%) with a linear scale ranging from 36 to 43 with tick marks every 1 unit. The secondary y-axis, on the right, represents Inference time (ms) with a linear scale ranging from 33 to 40 with tick marks every 1 unit. A blue line with circular markers represents Accuracy (%), starting at 36.8% at an ST Token Number of 0, rising to 42.2% at an ST Token Number of 20, and then decreasing to 40.2% at an ST Token Number of 30. A red line with square markers represents Inference time (ms), beginning at 36.2 ms at an ST Token Number of 0, increasing to 37.2 ms at an ST Token Number of 20, and ending at 37.1 ms at an ST Token Number of 30.
